assumptions: The UI shares the API origin
One public/operator page needs no client router
decisions: Serve app/static/index.html at / and mount app/static under /_assets
Include static assets as setuptools package data
Apply UI-only CSP and additional browser security headers
evidence: Route inspection shows exact / and /_assets routes can be registered before /{code}
The underscore-prefixed asset route cannot collide with valid aliases
Existing API operations cover create, list, analytics, and disable workflows
risks: Unsafe DOM insertion could create XSS
Static assets need explicit package-data inclusion
summary: Mapped an additive same-origin UI onto the current API with no schema, service, database, or redirect behavior changes.
